scope: Observable behavior and presentation in the local Three.js and Kaigen source snapshots; engine algorithms may differ.
status_policy: Existing test files are coverage, not proof of a current pass. Pending and unavailable evidence never pass a parity gate.

threejs.revision: Source archive without Git metadata; lock content hashes instead of guessing a commit.

kaigen.local_capture: unavailable: hz engine dependency/CLI absent from local source archive
kaigen.hosted_status: Page loaded and rendered gameplay in the in-app browser; observational only.
kaigen.hosted_source_match: Unverified: published build cannot be equated with the local source archive.
kaigen.controlled_capture: Unavailable: no verified frame-addressed camera/scene adapter or equivalent laboratory.
kaigen.performance: Unmeasured under the sustained protocol; the hosted FPS overlay is not qualification.

comparison.world_space: Metres, Y up; catalogue cameras are in level space, looking toward target with vertical FOV in degrees.
comparison.seed_policy: Retain each implementation's source default. Equal numeric seeds would not make different RNG/generation algorithms equivalent.
comparison.lighting_policy: Match solar time and record actual world-space sun direction; current world rotations and Defold's 61-degree celestial rotation are not a lighting match.

quality.defold: Medium material tier, high photographic tier, production capture defaults; record all live settings.
quality.threejs: Ultra, with actual preset, framebuffer, renderer and metered exposure recorded per shot.
quality.kaigen: For future controlled captures fix Ultra and record actual settings; hosted automatic quality is observational only.

exposure.defold: Fixed multiplier 1, adaptation disabled by capture controller.
exposure.threejs: 90 lockstep frames, frozen simulation/time, actual GPU exposure readback and display multiplier recorded.
exposure.kaigen: Unknown until a controlled capture adapter is available.
exposure.equivalence: Unmatched exposure models: compare appearance, never infer equal radiance from equal multipliers.

comparison.repeatability: Fresh reference page per shot/repeat. Exact pixels only within matching backend, source, scene, camera, frame and settings.
comparison.laboratory: Export production Defold triangles into the Three.js level transform, with reference procedural recipes and uniform roughness spheres. Special glass/cutout/light fixtures remain pending.
comparison.cross_engine_gate: Human review of composition, material separation, contrast, colour and motion; no cross-engine pixel-equality score.

performance.status: User-selected Mac native and desktop browser at 60 FPS; other budgets are proposed engineering thresholds, not measurements.
performance.device_decision: 2026-10-15: Mac + desktop browser only, target 60 FPS. Mobile qualification is outside the current acceptance gate.

protocol.build: Release; report engine/browser/OS/GPU, device, preset, native framebuffer and internal resolution.
protocol.scenario: Continuous full-map traversal with six AI, firing/reloads, indoors/outdoors, grenades and settled/live ragdolls. Until those features exist, mark the full-load budget unqualified.
protocol.cold_load: Fresh process and generated resources; exclude download time from local generation and report network transfer separately.
protocol.frame_metric: Wall-clock presented-frame intervals; report p50/p95/p99/worst, CPU/GPU separately and dropped/disjoint samples.
protocol.memory_metric: Measured peak process resident memory plus separately reported GPU/resource estimates; estimates are not resident-memory measurements.
protocol.regression: No shader compilations during measured play; no monotonic live-resource growth across ten encounter resets.

devices.device: Available MacBook Pro, Apple M3 Pro, 18 GB

devices.availability: available; renderer-process memory scope must be recorded

adaptations.current: Full 104 m street and 20 footprints; connected W2/E1/E2 floors, ground-only E3, open infill arcades and bounded flat terrain. E2 interior and terrain boundary walls are Defold adaptations; detailed source architecture/dressing remains step 4.
adaptations.reference: Full authored market including E1/E3 interiors

adaptations.current: Collision-limited eye origin; rendered muzzle flash
2x head damage and no separate arm damage volumes
1–3 inspection, 6–8 weapons, F inspect, held crouch/prone
adaptations.reference: 1–3 weapons, I inspect, wheel switch, toggle crouch/prone

adaptations.current: RGBA16F qualified on Metal; encoded RGBA8 elsewhere

adaptations.reference: GPU metering with different lighting/radiometric scales

scenarios.procedure: Capture catalogue stills twice from fresh runs at the recorded camera, seed, solar time and quality; review identical-scene motion sweeps.
scenarios.expect: Within-backend repeats agree; every cross-engine image records actual settings and unsupported scenes remain pending.

scenarios.procedure: Traverse every street/flank/doorway/stair/floor and route six actors between all connected areas.
scenarios.expect: Reference entrances, cover and sightlines exist; no invalid floor links or geometry/collision disagreements.

scenarios.procedure: Compare street, courtyard, gate, ruined building and furnished-room compositions.
scenarios.expect: Reference silhouette, content density and traversable openings are present.

scenarios.feature: All surface recipes, weathering and filtering
scenarios.procedure: Inspect every recipe close up, at distance and grazing angles; sweep lit/shaded roughness rows.
scenarios.expect: Full catalogue including sand/corrugated/burlap/foliage, stable relief and no seams or cutout shimmer.
scenarios.implementation_notes: Nineteen runtime recipes, all three atlas tiers, shared leaf coverage in colour/depth/motion/sun/local shadows. Foliage uses world-projected two-sided cards and filtered distant coverage; matched reference UV/coverage and visual qualification remain open.

scenarios.procedure: Run stairs/slopes/low ceilings, sprint/slide/jump, mantle thick ledges and vault thin obstacles with blocked and clear landings.
scenarios.expect: Reference movement timing with no clipping, unsupported landings or frame-rate-dependent travel.

scenarios.procedure: Record walking, sprint/ADS transitions, strafe/turn, land, slide, mantle and damage sequences.
scenarios.expect: Reference spring timing and additive motion without camera collision violations.

scenarios.feature: Damage, regeneration, falls and player suppression
scenarios.procedure: Take timed hits, wait for recovery, fall from known heights and receive near misses; repeat with pause and death.
scenarios.expect: Delayed ramped regeneration, appropriate fall damage and suppression; no healing dead actors or duplicate damage.

scenarios.feature: Three weapons, fire modes and ammunition
scenarios.procedure: Fire each mode, reload tactical/empty, interrupt before/after mag transfer, switch and inspect at 30/60/144 presentation FPS.
scenarios.expect: Matching rates, chambers, ammunition transfers and interruption rules; correct requested weapon in capture.

scenarios.procedure: Capture every weapon hip/ADS/reload/inspect indoors and outdoors, plus camera turns and walking.
scenarios.expect: Reference silhouettes and hand grips; aligned optics and lag/sway without broken joints.

scenarios.procedure: Shoot bare targets, thin wood, thick concrete, overlapping layers and a muzzle-obstructing wall with fixed seeds.
scenarios.expect: Reference attenuation/deflection, complete travelled-segment checks and documented origin behavior.

scenarios.procedure: Hit head, upper/lower torso, arms and legs while actors move and crouch.
scenarios.expect: Reference regional scales and correct skeleton-driven volumes; one damage application per actor per round.

scenarios.procedure: Show all variants walking/running/crouching/turning on stairs, aiming, reloading, vaulting and reacting to hits.
scenarios.expect: Reference equipment/anatomy, grounded feet, attached hands, matching shadows and motion vectors.

scenarios.procedure: Kill actors on floors/stairs/beside walls; fire/reload repeatedly; apply blast impulses and reset ten times.
scenarios.expect: Stable physical settling and impulses, bounded lifetime/sleep/resource counts.

scenarios.feature: Hearing, search, cover, bursts, reload and flank
scenarios.procedure: Approach unseen with noise, break visual contact, pin cover, wound an actor, hold position and obstruct a route.
scenarios.expect: No omniscience; investigation/retreat, squad peek permissions, tall-cover peeks, burst/reload cycles and useful flanks.

scenarios.procedure: Trigger squad throws toward exposed and covered targets; pause mid-fuse and restart before detonation.
scenarios.expect: Rationed throws, bounce/fuse, obstruction-aware blast, impulses and synchronized warning/FX/audio.

scenarios.procedure: Fire into each surface, kill actors, detonate grenades, walk/land and inspect smoke, motes and heat haze.
scenarios.expect: Full effect catalogue, correct sorting/receivers and bounded pools during sustained fire.

scenarios.procedure: Capture fixed day/sunset/night indoors/outdoors, then animate time and cloud cover across a full transition.
scenarios.expect: Consistent light/environment/shadows, moving cloud influence and no stale reflection or temporal trails.

scenarios.feature: HDR, shadows, AO, TAA, reflections and photography
scenarios.procedure: Run HDR probes and feature on/off/return pixels; inspect thin edges, moving soldiers, glass and ADS with optical effects.
scenarios.expect: Feature contribution, stable history and isolated weapon/GUI; comparable source appearance remains a review gate.

scenarios.procedure: Listen to every weapon/surface, enemy steps/barks, near misses, explosions, heartbeat and UI; repeat indoors/outdoors.
scenarios.expect: Reference timbre and event timing with generated sounds, bounded voices and no stale cues.

scenarios.procedure: Move an audible source behind cover and across room boundaries; combine footsteps, automatic fire and a nearby blast.
scenarios.expect: Continuous obstruction/reverb changes, spatial localization, ducking and concussion without clipping.

scenarios.procedure: Fight and reload, receive hits from several bearings, see offscreen grenades, switch floors and resize/pause/restart.
scenarios.expect: Contacts, damage numbers, kill banners, grenade indicators and readable bounded layouts with correct lifecycle.

scenarios.feature: Mouse, gamepad, touch and user settings
scenarios.procedure: Complete traversal/combat/menu/restart flows separately with each device; change FOV/inversion/presets and return focus.
scenarios.expect: Reference bindings, toggles, defaults and no stuck inputs; actual browser pointer lock and touch/audio activation verified.

scenarios.procedure: Run the specified sustained protocol for every target preset/device; change manual/automatic quality during combat.
scenarios.expect: Recorded budgets, stable adaptation, manual override, no gameplay shader compiles and no resource growth.

scenarios.procedure: Run all scenarios on target devices, inject WebGL context loss, resize, background/resume and repeat quality changes.
scenarios.expect: Generated resources recover; HDR or documented fallback works; full gameplay/input/audio and sustained budgets qualify.

exclusions: Objective game mode inferred from UI hooks
